chapters.title: Welcome: why TDM exists and the data basics you need
chapters.summary: Start from zero: what test data is, why copying production is dangerous, how TDM fits into software testing, and the database and file basics every later chapter relies on.

chapters.title: Privacy, discovery, subsetting and masking: the concepts
chapters.summary: The sensitive data and laws that shape every project, then three of the four core techniques explained in plain words before any tool appears: finding data, shrinking it, and hiding it safely.

chapters.title: Synthetic data, ETL from scratch, and how ETL meets TDM
chapters.summary: The fourth technique, making test data from nothing, then extract-transform-load step by step, and how ETL and TDM overlap, differ and work together.

chapters.title: Informatica TDM (1): architecture, the tool tour, discovery and subsetting
chapters.summary: How Informatica TDM is built, a guided tour of Test Data Manager, then discovering sensitive data and keys and carving out a data subset.

chapters.title: Informatica TDM (2): masking, generation, plans and workflows
chapters.summary: Every masking technique and rule, mapplets and transformations, data generation, and how plans become workflows you monitor.

chapters.title: GenRocket (1): the building blocks
chapters.summary: What GenRocket is, then its core pieces in order: domains, attributes, generators, receivers and scenarios.

chapters.title: GenRocket (2): data patterns and a hands-on build
chapters.summary: Sequential, random, boundary, edge-case and null data, then a full lab generating 50 customer records.

chapters.title: Delphix (1): connecting, keys and profiling
chapters.summary: What the Delphix masking engine is, connecting to databases and a VDB, rule sets and primary keys, and profiling to find sensitive data.

chapters.title: Delphix (2): algorithms, file masking and hands-on labs
chapters.summary: Masking algorithms and jobs, masking txt and dat files, and the Delphix lab series from connector to masked output.

chapters.title: Putting it together: real engagements, a worked project and the glossary
chapters.summary: How a real TDM engagement is planned and signed off, a worked end-to-end project, and a glossary of every term used in the guide.
